theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁ with
  | refl => use a₂; exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  | red_I a =>
    use a; exact ⟨.refl a, h₂⟩
  | red_K a b =>
    let ⟨a', h'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a b a₂ h₂
    use a'
    exact ⟨h'.1, .red_K a' b⟩
  | red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c)
      exact ⟨.refl _, .red_S a b c⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      let ⟨a', b', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rw [h.2.2]
      use a' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b' ⬝ c')
      constructor
      · apply ParallelReduction.par
        · exact .par h.left hc
        · exact .par h.2.1 hc
      · exact .red_S a' b' c'
    case red_S =>
      use a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c)
      exact ⟨.refl _, .refl _⟩
    case red_I => contradiction
    case red_K => contradiction
  | par a a' b b' ha hb =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      use a' ⬝ b'
      exact ⟨.refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
      let ⟨a₃, ha₃⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
      let ⟨b₃, hb₃⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
      use a₃ ⬝ b₃
      exact ⟨.par ha₃.1 hb₃.1, .par ha₃.2 hb₃.2⟩
    case red_S => contradiction
    case red_I => contradiction
    case red_K => contradiction
